label: V6.2.7 CANDIDATE r2 - synchronized J2/J3 recovery
notes: Offline candidate. Begin both recovery pulses only after the planned push ends; slow and reduce the J2 rearward lift pulse so it does not outrun J3. A small shared 6 mm Z envelope preserves swing clearance while both joints unfold in motion. Preserve first FR/RL entry, normal J1 hold, paired X/Z timing, stance endpoints and Stop placements. Installed acceleration caps, command delay, collision and tracking guards remain unchanged. Phase-defined push completion is not a measurement of exhausted propulsion.
